segments.speaker: Maya Chen, Account Executive
segments.text:
Hi Dan,

Following up on the renewal quote for 42 seats, Feb 1, 2026 through Jan 31, 2027.

Current paper is at $31,920 annually, billed upfront, with the standard 30-day opt-out on the services package. Go-live support stays included for the reporting workspace refresh on Feb 10.

Can you confirm if 42 is still the right count?

Maya

segments.speaker: Dan Miller, IT Operations Manager
segments.text:
Hi Maya,

42 is right for now. We may add 6 more after Q2 but finance wants the renewal flat if possible.

The invoice needs to hit us by Jan 12 or it gets pushed to February processing.

Dan

segments.speaker: Maya Chen, Account Executive
segments.text:
Dan,

Got it. I can keep the add-on seats co-termed later if you need them.

For the Jan 12 invoice timing, I need signature by Jan 9 at the latest. Billing usually needs one business day to generate the invoice.

On price, I can check what room we have, but the pricing sheet has this at $31,920 for 42 seats.

Maya

segments.speaker: Dan Miller, IT Operations Manager
segments.text:
Maya,

Understood. If you can get it closer to $29k, I can probably get Molly to sign this week. Otherwise she may ask me to rebid it, which I do not want to do.

No changes needed to terms besides the invoice date.

Dan

segments.speaker: Maya Chen, Account Executive
segments.text:
Dan,

Per our message thread, let's use $29,400 for the renewal and keep the same 42 seats and dates. I'll get the order form updated now and sort the deal desk paperwork after so billing can stay on track for Jan 12.

Sending the revised PDF shortly.

Maya

segments.speaker: Dan Miller, IT Operations Manager
segments.text:
Thanks. $29,400 works.

Please make sure the PO field is blank on the order form. We will send PO-11873 after Molly signs, but AP asked us not to put a placeholder in the contract.

Dan

segments.speaker: Maya Chen, Account Executive
segments.text:
Dan,

Attached is the revised order form:

42 seats
Term: Feb 1, 2026 - Jan 31, 2027
Annual fee: $29,400
Billing: upfront
PO field: blank
Services package: included, 30-day opt-out

If Molly signs by Friday, I can get the invoice request submitted the same day.

Maya

segments.speaker: Dan Miller, IT Operations Manager
segments.text:
Maya,

Looks good. Molly signed and I attached the PDF.

Please send the invoice to ap@northlineparts.com and copy me. PO-11873 should be issued tomorrow morning.

Dan

segments.speaker: Maya Chen, Account Executive
segments.text:
Dan,

Received, thank you. I submitted the signed order to billing and noted PO-11873 is pending.

You should see the invoice by Jan 12. I'll also have our onboarding lead send a calendar hold for the Feb 10 reporting workspace refresh.

Maya
